title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon Becomes Africa's First Abbott World Marathon Majors Race
claims: On 10 June 2026 the Sanlam Cape Town Marathon was confirmed as the first Abbott World Marathon Major to be held on African soil.
The event passed the second and final stage of its AbbottWMM assessment and became the eighth member of the series.
It joins Tokyo, Boston, London, Sydney, Berlin, Chicago and New York, and formally enters the series at its next edition on 23 May 2027.
The 2026 race was staged on 24 May 2026.
Approximately 80% of the world's top 50 elite marathon runners come from Africa, and the event commits to keeping two-thirds of its race entries available to African participants.
The 2027 general ballot ran from 10 to 24 June 2026, with applicants notified on 26 June 2026; Peace Run and Trail Run entries opened on 3 July 2026.
The 2025 race could not go ahead.
Eliud Kipchoge chose Cape Town for his first official marathon on African soil.
The event is projected to contribute in the region of R800 million through local travel, accommodation and meals.
